'''Scout Armor''' was a light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] suit produced by [[Voyage Enterprises]] for reconnaissance missions. While initially developed for corporate [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], the suit proved to be very popular among [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinders]]. The suit provided lightweight protection to the scout and had an inbuilt equipment harness for storing supplies. It also had integrated [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] and [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] with a 6-hour filter.<ref name="RoE" /> The armor also had [[Heating unit|heater units]] allowing the suit to be employed in areas with little to no [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
